cards.title: Show stock on a product card
cards.body:
## Why

Shoppers add teas we have run out of and only find out at checkout.

## What

Each product card shows how many are in stock. The API already keeps `stock` per product but does not return it.

- Return `stock` from `GET /api/products`.
- Show it on the product card in the front end.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A product with more than 3 in stock shows **In stock**.
- [ ] A product with 1 to 3 in stock shows **Only N left**.
- [ ] A product with none shows **Out of stock** and its Add to cart button is disabled.
- [ ] `GET /api/products` includes `stock` for each product.

cards.title: The cart total ignores quantity
cards.body:
## Steps

1. Seed and start the shop (`npm run seed`, then `npm run dev -w api` and `npm run dev -w web`).
2. Add Assam Breakfast to the cart and press + twice, so the quantity is 3.
3. Look at the cart.

The line says €29.70 but the Total says €9.90: the total counts each product once, whatever its quantity.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The cart total is the sum of each line's unit price times its quantity.
- [ ] The skipped test pinning this in `api/test/cart.test.ts` runs and passes.

cards.title: Pin the Node version
cards.body:
CI says Node 22 in the workflow and the repo says nothing. Pin it in one place.

- Add `.nvmrc` with `22`.
- Add `"engines": { "node": ">=22 <23" }` to the root `package.json`.
- Let CI read the version with `node-version-file: .nvmrc`.

No behaviour changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.nvmrc` says `22`.
- [ ] The root `package.json` has `engines.node` set to Node 22.
- [ ] CI reads the version from `.nvmrc` (`node-version-file`) and stays green.
- [ ] No change to the app's behaviour.
